# Online Payment Processing with Stripe

Stripe provides infrastructure for online payment processing across 135+ currencies. Designed for developers and growing enterprises.

## Payment Features
Accept credit cards, mobile wallets, and regional bank transfers with a single integration.

## Transparent Pricing
Pricing starts at 2.9% + 30¢ per successful card charge. Custom pricing available for large volume businesses.

## Global Support and Contact
Contact us at support@stripe.com or visit our headquarters in San Francisco, California.

Built for developers, internet businesses, and fast-scaling enterprises.
